[[Frostbite]] is a [[Nightmare]] [[boss]] that spawns in [[Talus Chute]] and the [[Ice Floe]].

== Locations ==
* [[Southern Shiverpeaks]]
** {{NPC location|Ice Floe}}
** {{NPC location|Talus Chute}}

== Skills ==
14 [[Smiting Prayers]] (19 Smiting Prayers in [[Hard mode]])
* {{skill icon|Holy Wrath}}
* {{skill icon|Retribution}}
* {{skill icon|Signet of Judgment}} ([[elite]])

== Items dropped ==
* [[Azure Remains]]

== Notes==
* Frostbite has three possible spawn locations in Talus Chute, which he shares with three other Nightmare bosses.
* The easiest way to find him in Talus Chute is to repeatedly zone from [[Camp Rankor]] until he spawns at the closest location, which allows for finding him with minimal effort.
* He hardly ever spawns in the Ice Floe. On the other hand, be aware that he will only appear once you approach his location, which is near the tree in the center of the small area enclosed by a low wall right outside the gate of [[Thunderhead Keep (outpost)|Thunderhead Keep]]. When Frostbite appears, 12 Azure Shadows will pop up from the ground and they can kill your whole party with a Signet of Judgment spike, so spread out.

== Trivia ==
* Killing Frostbite was the object of a now-removed beta [[quest]], [[Slay Frostbite]].
